name: Big Sky RV Park & Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.1348,-112.9541: a row of RV pads along the foot of a bare hillside beside the Copper Sands Rd buildings on the north side of Anaconda; Warm Springs Creek runs ~60-80 m south behind the road and a tree band, no sightline from the pads; not waterfront

name: Beaverhead Inn and RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 240 m and 600 m frames) at 44.6332,-112.5921: L-shaped motel with gravel RV spots behind it by the I-15 interchange in Lima; no water in frame; not waterfront

name: River Edge Resort RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 47.0038,-114.4919: resort buildings and RV sites on a bench along the north bank of the Clark Fork; the sites sit ~35-55 m from the water with a band of riverbank trees and brush between, gaps in it toward the river; no open apron to the water, so view, not on-water; riverview

name: Wagon Wheel Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 46.2621,-106.6590: small loop of RV sites in open grassland beside Slaughterhouse Creek Rd west of I-94; only a dry draw with brush nearby; not waterfront

name: Duck Lake Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 48.8625,-113.3232: campground loops in scrub/aspen on the bench above Duck Lake's south shore; a wide sand beach lies between the brush and the water, with the nearest pads ~30-50 m from the beach edge through brush - lake visible, no clear open apron from the pads to the water; lakeview

name: Heritage Hills Farm RV and Camp Sites
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 48.5549,-107.3558: open prairie field by a gravel road north of Saco, dispersed sites with no developed pads; the Milk River valley is a distant view, no water within ~1 km; not waterfront

name: Spotted Bear Campground (Flathead NF)
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 47.9278,-113.5252: campground loop roads under continuous conifer canopy; the South Fork Flathead / Spotted Bear River lie ~150-250 m south below the bench (FS: 'most of the campsites are located above the river'); canopy can't confirm a sightline, defaults down; not waterfront
